# jamfpro_v3_computer_prestage (Resource)

Retrieve a Computer Prestage with the supplied id.

### Optional

- `anchor_certificates` (Set of String) The Base64 encoded PEM Certificate
- `enable_recovery_lock` (Boolean)
- `enrollment_customization_id` (String)
- `language` (String)
- `manifest_url` (String) The URL to the manifest file for the Platform SSO (PSSO) application 403 workflow. This URL is used when deploying the PSSO app to devices during the setup process.
- `minimum_os_specific_version` (String)
- `platform_sso_app_bundle_id` (String) The bundle identifier for the Platform SSO (PSSO) application unattended workflow. This identifier is used to specify which PSSO app should be deployed to devices during the setup process.
- `prestage_minimum_os_target_version_type` (String)
- `profile_url` (String) The URL to the configuration profile for the Platform SSO (PSSO) application 403 workflow. This URL is used when deploying the PSSO app to devices during the setup process. Users should use either profileUrl or populate pssoConfigProfileId, but not both.
- `psso_config_profile_id` (String) The identifier for the configuration profile associated with the Platform SSO (PSSO) application 403 workflow. This ID is used to specify which configuration profile should be applied to devices during the setup process when PSSO is enabled. Users should use either pssoConfigProfileId or populate profileUrl, but not both.
- `psso_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether Platform SSO (PSSO) is enabled for this computer prestage, regardless of unattended or 403 workflows. When enabled, the PSSO application will be deployed to devices during the setup process to facilitate single sign-on (SSO) for users.
- `recovery_lock_password_type` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `rotate_recovery_lock_password` (Boolean)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `profile_uuid` (String)
- `site_id` (String)
- `version_lock` (Number)
